geometry: Two identical white right-pointing triangles on a transparent 20 by 20 canvas. Their vertical edges begin at x=3 and x=11; each is approximately 5.5 units wide and 7.34 units tall, centered at y=10. The native and 8x renders were produced and the 8x rendering inspected.
limitations: Straight vector edges approximate the original antialiased pixel coverage. Position and scale were tuned against the original; the updated 8x rendering was inspected.
